name: Andorra

fees.name: De facto: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) via France or Spain
fees.validity: up to 90 days in 180 (Schengen); Andorra itself imposes no limit via visa
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a Schengen visa; must be double/multiple-entry to re-enter Schengen after leaving Andorra
fees.notes: Andorra issues no visas of its own. Entry is only possible through France or Spain, so the standard Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 adults, EUR 45 children 6-11, since 11 June 2024) applies de facto for visa-required nationalities. Apply at a French or Spanish consulate/visa centre.

vfs.note: Andorra has no visa regime and no outsourced visa centres. France and Spain (the de facto issuing states) use TLScontact/VFS Global/BLS International respectively in many countries; their service fees vary by centre and are recorded under FRA/ESP.

free_visa_notes: Andorra does not require or issue any visa for entry (official Govern d'Andorra position); a passport (or EU national ID card) suffices. However, Andorra is landlocked between France and Spain and is not in the Schengen Area, so visa-required nationalities need a double- or multiple-entry Schengen visa (EUR 90) from France or Spain to reach and leave Andorra.
